name: Ultimate Swampfire
abilities: Blue napalm-fire generation (ignited kerosene gel; far hotter than Swampfire's flames)
Enhanced chlorokinesis (plant control), seed and vine generation
Underwater breathing and underwater fire generation
weaknesses: Vulnerable to electricity (e.g. Ra'ad, Ultimate Aggregor)
Body of petrified wood is still a plant: relies on regeneration to shrug off heavy damage
summary: The Ultimatrix's evolved Methanosian: a walking tree of petrified wood carrying blue kerosene-napalm pods that fuel searing blue fire, throwable fire bombs and jet-propelled flight. Ben's first Ultimate form.
traits: First Ultimate form Ben ever used
Blue napalm gel shells on arms, back and face pod
Designed by Steven Choi; Derrick J. Wyatt's favourite Ultimate
notableFeats: Debuted against Vilgax aboard the sinking Chimeran Hammer, fighting and breathing underwater (The Final Battle: Part 2)
Led the team into Los Soledad and easily wrecked the Aggrebots (Ultimate Aggregor)
Blue flames melted through a brick wall (Ultimate Aggregor)
Forced the Plant Alien's mouth open and destroyed it with a single fire bomb (The Big Story)
Snuck up on Eon unnoticed before being aged to dust by his time ray, later restored by Ben 10,000 (Ben 10,000 Returns)

appearances.designNotes: Dark-brown humanoid tree of petrified wood; three blue gooey kerosene shells on each arm, a large one on the back and a small pod on the chest/face through which his green eyes show; evolved (four-spiked) green Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Identical to the UA design.

scoring.rationale: Blue napalm melts brick, cluster bombs cover a wide area and a single fire bomb destroyed the Plant Alien; keeps Swampfire's regeneration, vines and elasticity and adds jet flight and underwater fire. Still a plant body that electricity (Ra'ad, Ultimate Aggregor) shuts down, and Eon's time ray dusted him. Rated a clear step above Swampfire but below the true heavy hitters.

notes: The wiki files The Final Battle under AF 'Season 2' (production numbering); by broadcast it is the AF S3 finale and Ben is 16, hence usedBy ben-16-af.
Only Ultimate form used by Ben before Ultimate Alien.
Also listed by the wiki as a dream figment cameo in 'Night of the Living Nightmare' (Albedo's dream) - not counted as a notable episode.
Only Ultimate form to be temporarily destroyed (aged to dust by Eon) and then restored (Ben 10,000 Returns).

Sentient Ultimates storyline (UA S3, 'The Ultimate Sacrifice'): the six most-used Ultimate forms (Humungousaur, Swampfire, Spidermonkey, Big Chill, Cannonbolt, Echo Echo) gained sentience inside the Ultimatrix and demanded freedom; Ben offered his life, Azmuth freed them to their own world and reworked the Ultimatrix so Ultimates are 'empty shells' again.

Ultimate forms are artificial by-products of the Ultimatrix's evolutionary function (added by Albedo): the DNA is run through a simulated worst-case scenario over millions of theoretical years to force combat-oriented evolution. They are not natural Codon Stream species, and the Omniverse Omnitrix has no evolutionary function, so Ben never regains them after UA (Derrick J. Wyatt).
Video-game/comic uses (Cosmic Destruction, FusionFall, Action Pack comics) not counted as appearances.
